peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 17.8% below its local comparables; 5 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (50.9): 3.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 27 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 370 m, Little India MRT about 920 m; closer than 21 of 63 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 380 m; more than 55 of 63 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 260 m), more than 39 of 63 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 180 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,250 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 540 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,130 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,270 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,420 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,520 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,590 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,610 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 363 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 85 new sales and 1,010 resales (1,095 purchases); new sales were 7.8% of these purchases. Subsales (51) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,010 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 57 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,010 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,079 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.4%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
